title: IndiaMART Leads to WhatsApp
seoTitle: IndiaMART Leads to WhatsApp: Instant Response Setup
seoDescription: Send an instant WhatsApp reply to every IndiaMART enquiry and alert the right salesperson. How it works, template approval and lead routing.
summary: An IndiaMART–WhatsApp integration picks up each new IndiaMART enquiry, sends the buyer an approved WhatsApp message within minutes, and alerts the right salesperson with the buyer's requirement. Responding first often decides who wins an IndiaMART lead.

dataPoints.label: Lead source
dataPoints.value: IndiaMART lead manager API or pull integration

dataPoints.label: Message type
dataPoints.value: Approved WhatsApp template with the product and a catalogue or call link

dataPoints.label: Routing
dataPoints.value: By product, city or round-robin to salespeople

body:
## Why speed matters

Buyers on IndiaMART contact several suppliers. An immediate, specific reply with a catalogue link stands out from a call three hours later.

## Keep it in a CRM

Log every lead and reply in a CRM so follow-ups are not lost. See [IndiaMART and Zoho CRM](/integrations/indiamart-zoho-crm) and the [WhatsApp Business API](/glossary/whatsapp-business-api).

Tool features and APIs change; confirm current capabilities before scoping.

faqs.q: Do buyers have to opt in?
faqs.a: Follow WhatsApp's current business messaging and opt-in policies; use approved templates for first contact.

faqs.q: Can AI qualify the lead first?
faqs.a: Yes. See AI sales enquiry qualification for scoring and routing.
